QuestInfo.name: A Fine Piece of Bluffery
QuestInfo.0: #p1401000# is so strict. How could he expect the greatest thief ever to exist wouldn't show a little bit of pizazz after hundreds of years away?
QuestInfo.1: However, #p1401000# may have a point. You are far too weak to battle any of the Black Mage's minions at this point. You need to do some training!\n\n#o1210102##r #a254011##k
QuestInfo.2: When did the #o1210102# become such a tough beast? You used to be so tough!

0.0: Shaking Hilla was a good step, but the #p1101000# Knights must continue to believe that you are as powerful as you once were. At your level, you could barely handle a mushroom... \r\n#L0##bThat hurts, Gaston. You know I used to be a very high level. It's not my fault the Black Mage cursed me!#l\n#k
0.1: It actually was your fault, master. Regardless, the important thing now is to reach your level before anyone notices what a hopeless weakling you've become.\r\n#L0##bYou are just nasty today! But you have a point. I'll get back to my training, despite the fact that I have no desire to do so. I'll show these new people that I am still the greatest thief of all time!#l\n#k
0.2: Of course, master. I have already prepared a batch of creatures of your level at the #bTraining Center#k. It should be a good test of your abilities.

yes.0: In the Training Center, you will find the utterly terrifying #r#o1210102##k. It may not appear to be much, but do not overestimate its stout frame... hehehehe...

no.0: Certainly you don't have anything more important to do...

1.0: How was the training, master? \r\n#L0##bI'm... so frustrated...#l\n#k
1.1: Frustrated?\r\n#L0##bYes! How am I ever going to get back to my previous level at this rate?!#l\n#k
1.2: ...hehe\r\n#L0##bI had totally forgotten about the difficulties of being weak! I never liked training! It doesn't suit me... #l\n#k
1.3: Master, please, you are making me laugh...\r\n#L0##bDon't you dare! Don't you dare laugh at my plight! I will make the Black Mage rue the day he cursed me!#l\n#k
1.4: Master, you have been given a new chance at life. Do not sit here and wallow in the fact that you'll have to do a little bit of hard work to make it more enjoyable.

mob.0: You still haven't gone to the Training Center? I believe you created the #bTraining Center#k on the #m150000000# for times like these.
